table.retrieve:
Select 
	Customer = (Select name From Accounts Where Accounts.Acccode = C.custcode ) ,
	CustomerCatCode=(select custcatcode from customer where customer.custcode=C.custcode),
	custcode = c.custcode,
	Godown = (SELECT G.Name FROM Godown G WHERE G.Gcode=C.GCode),
	RegNo  = IsNull( (Select RegNo From Patient  Where patientcode = C.PatientCode ) , '' ),
	PatientName  = IsNull( (Select Name From Patient  Where patientcode = C.PatientCode ) , 'N/A' ),
	SaleValue = Sum ( CASE C.Type When 'S' Then dbo.Fn_getSaleInvTotal(C.InvCode) Else 0 End ),
	ReturnValue = Sum ( CASE C.Type When 'SR' Then dbo.Fn_getSRInvTotal(C.InvCode) Else 0 End ),
	LastTransDate = Max(C.Date)
From 
	(Select saleinvcode As InvCode, custcode, patientcode, date, Type = 'S', GCode=(SELECT MAX(D.GCode) FROM SaleDetail D WHERE D.SaleInvCode=SaleLedger.SaleInvCode)
	From SaleLedger
	Where Date Between :ar_sdate And :ar_ldate And Custcode In (:al_custcode) 
	Union All
	Select srinvcode As InvCode, custcode, patientcode, date, Type = 'SR', GCode=(SELECT MAX(D.GCode) FROM SRDetail D WHERE D.SRInvCode=SRLedger.SRInvCode)
	From SRLedger 
	Where Date Between :ar_sdate And :ar_ldate And Custcode In (:al_custcode)) C 
Group By 
	C.custcode , C.patientcode, C.GCode
table.sort: customer A, patientname A, regno A, godown A
